While everyone’s eyes are glued to the Middle East, Beijing is making its long-awaited move on Taiwan.

And the pieces have been quietly falling into place for months.
This is what the next 30 days could look like.

DAY 1 — It starts with two ships most people have never heard of. The Dongguan and the Anqing. China’s brand new Type 055 guided missile destroyers, each carrying 112 vertical launch systems capable of firing hypersonic anti-ship ballistic missiles with a 2,000km range, were just quietly reassigned to the Eastern Theater Command. The command responsible for Taiwan. USNI News reported this on March 11. Nobody in mainstream media ran with it.

DAY 3 — The Type 055s don’t operate alone. They anchor a surface action group. Flanked by Type 052D destroyers and supported by Type 054A frigates, the formation moves into position. State media calls it a readiness patrol. Taiwan’s radar operators call their superiors.

DAY 5 — This isn’t new behavior, it’s a pattern being pushed to its logical conclusion. In December 2024, China deployed nearly 90 warships in a single operation. Taiwan’s own Defense Ministry called it the largest maritime deployment since 1996. General Hsieh Jih-sheng stood at a press conference and said the numbers were, quote, “astonishing.” The world shrugged.

DAY 7 — Then in late 2025 came “Justice Mission 2025.” China surrounded Taiwan with 89 military aircraft, 14 naval vessels and 14 coast guard ships simultaneously. Live fire drills. Simulated port blockades. Danger zones for artillery closer to the island than in any previous exercise on record. All of this already happened. All of it was rehearsal.

DAY 10 — The blockade does not announce itself. No declaration. No red phone call. Just ships forming two walls. One at the Taiwan Strait. One further east in the Pacific, cutting off any allied response from Japan or the Philippines. Taiwan’s Defense Ministry already identified this exact formation in December 2024 and warned the world. The world did not listen.

DAY 14 — TSMC goes dark. Not destroyed. Just unreachable. Every semiconductor dependent supply chain on earth, Apple, Nvidia, Samsung, ASML, begins running on reserves. The economic shockwave hits markets before a single missile is fired.

DAY 18 — Washington begins emergency redeployment of carrier strike groups from the Gulf. Pentagon war games have consistently shown the transit time is too long to matter in the opening phase. Beijing ran those same war games. Beijing planned around that number.

DAY 21 — The conversation the world is now having is no longer “will China move on Taiwan.” It is “what does the West offer to make the ships go home.” That negotiation, forced, on Beijing’s terms, at Beijing’s timing, was always the actual objective.

 Every ship name above is real and newly assigned. Every exercise above was documented and reported. Every formation above was already publicly flagged by Taiwan’s own generals.

The Pentagon has warned China aims to be ready to take Taiwan by 2027. 

The Dongguan and Anqing just joined the command that would execute it. The Middle East has US naval assets stretched thin.

The window has never been more open.

Watch Taiwan.
